name: primitives-effects-click

frames.best_why: A thin ring is expanding around the Ring button while all five buttons and the caption stay fully visible.

tagline: Buttons that fire a ring, ripple or crosshair where you click.
summary: A row of labelled demo buttons; pressing one draws a short white effect at the pointer, with variants for a ring, a ripple, a crosshair, a burst and particles.
appearance: Five dark grey rounded buttons in a row on a black stage, the fifth centred below, each with a white capitalised label. A small grey caption under the row tells you to click.
behaviour: Clicking anywhere on a button spawns the chosen effect at the pointer: an expanding circle, a filled ripple, four ticks pulling outward, a fan of strokes or a spray of dots. Each fades within a second.
demo_content: Buttons reading Ring, Ripple, Crosshair, Burst and Particles, with the caption Click a button to see its effect.
use_when: Buttons or icons need playful tap feedback that confirms where the pointer landed.
avoid_when: Effects fire on pointer only, so keyboard activation shows nothing, and five variants add noise.
customise: Pass children to wrap plus variant, colour, size, duration, scope and disabled; the five effect shapes and easing curves are fixed in source.
weight_why: Each click mounts a few SVG shapes for under a second; idle at rest.

a11y.note: The effect fires only on pointerup, so keyboard-triggered clicks give no feedback; reduced motion is respected.

issues: Crosshair and burst marks are thin on the dark stage and easy to miss.
The caption is small grey text with weak contrast against black.
polish_why: Clean dark buttons and varied effects; thin lines on black make two variants hard to see.
title: Click
